title: Replace generated Wiki snapshots without retaining retired pages
requirements: Track the page identities owned by generated Wiki publication across process restarts. Remove obsolete owned pages on a successful replacement, including an empty snapshot.
Never remove unowned manual documents. Dry-run is read-only, ownership metadata is validated before mutations, and malformed or escaping page identifiers cannot delete external files.
Failed page writes preserve the prior ownership manifest and old pages. A runtime reader with a warm cache no longer returns retired generated pages after publication.
